title: Restriction A: no theory describes the observations of all agents

statements.text: Extended Wigner's friend scenarios, agent duplication and the Boltzmann brain problem share one structural feature, Restriction A: a physical theory cannot give a probabilistic description of the observations of all agents. The gist of Wigner's friend can be reproduced without quantum physics.
